messages:
Maya: Quick mid-quarter check — posting a compact status ask for runtime + infra cross-team owners. Please reply with: shipped / slipped / blocked + owner + next action.
Alex: Shipped -> prefix-cache prototype deployed to staging; owner @alex; next: run perf battery and sanity tests, aim to promote if green. :tada:
Jordan: Slipped -> autoscale canary (policy v2) delayed due to infra window; owner @jordan; next: reschedule canary to next Tue, need infra ops approval.
Sanjay: Blocked -> quantized kernel integration hitting OOM on 8GB nodes during KV-cache runs; owner @sanjay; reproducer attached.
Sanjay: Reproducer snippet:
```
OOM at mem_alloc kernel 0x7fff
batch_size=32 seq_length=1024
Backtrace: gpu_alloc -> kernel_exec -> kv_cache_write
```
Maya: Re: OOM — try lowering batch_size to 16 on staging and rerun. If still OOM, fallback canary to non-quantized variant and note perf delta.
Sanjay: Will try batch_size=16 now, pinging when done.
Alex: PR for cache proto: https://github.com/redwood-inference/cache-proto/pull/312 — needs one more review from @Maya (minor TTL config change).
Maya: Reviewing today; requested change: default TTL -> 30s, and add a small integration test for prefix eviction.
Jordan: Docs dependency: SDK docs need a short note about opt-in cache flag and example. Assigned to @Sam.
Sam: Ack — will add docs + sample snippet by EOD Monday.
Maya: Compact recap for milestone board: shipped=prefix-cache->staging (Alex); slipped=autoscale canary -> reschedule (Jordan); blocked=quant kernel OOM -> mitigation attempt (Sanjay). Next actions: Alex perf run, Sam docs patch, Jordan secures infra window, Sanchay? (typo) => Sanjay runs batch_size=16 test. Updating milestone owners now.
deploy-bot: Deploy started: cache-proto -> staging (build 2024.07.21-88) :rocket:
Sanjay: Batch_size=16 resolved OOM on staging; running perf sweep now, ETA ~45m.
Alex: Nice — if perf delta <5% we schedule canary for next Tue and notify infra ops.
Jordan: I'll update the milestone board, set owners, and send a short calendar invite for canary window. Thanks all. :pray:
